text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A rare day off.
I decided to wear the stylish outfit North
Flight picked out for me before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I set out to go somewhere,
but... I suddenly froze in my tracks.
Where on earth does one go in an outfit this
chic?
choice_data_list: (I have nowhere to wear this to!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, look at that outfit!
Heading out somewhere, Trainer?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she went through the trouble of choosing
it, I wanted to wear it out more.
Feeling that way,
I honestly laid out my dilemma.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So that's what's troubling you...!
I understand completely. Matching time,
place, and occasion can be tricky.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, that's "casual wear,"
so as long as it isn't a formal ceremony,
you can wear it anywhere! ...However.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Since you went to the effort of dressing up,
wouldn't you prefer somewhere that fits the
mood? If you'd like,
allow me to guide you to some recommended
spots!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
North Flight quickly changed into daywear,
and we headed out together.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—First stop, right here♪ An art museum
is the perfect venue for a day when you've
dressed up with effortless chic.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They have an outdoor exhibition right now,
so we can appreciate the artwork while taking
a leisurely stroll along the promenade.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An intellectual space that isn't overly stuffy,
offering an inspiring brush with the
extraordinary...
It truly was a perfect match for today's
glamorous look.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Here is Fuu-chan's top styling tip!
When touring indoor exhibits,
just be mindful of shoes that make loud
clicking noises♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If you're in heels,
walking slowly rather than rushing creates
an elegant aura. Though above all,
enjoying yourself without stiffening up is
what matters most.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
On days you dress up,
your polished self is a work of art in its
own right, wouldn't you say?
With a free spirit,
let us immerse ourselves in high-taste
elegance♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Next is the aquarium...
That fantastical ambiance is simply dripping
with atmosphere.
Those beautiful creatures are packed with
the raw "beauty" crafted by nature itself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The sound of water is wonderfully
relaxing as well...
Gazing at them like this makes you forget
the daily hustle and bustle.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I sometimes come here all by myself just to
get lost in thought.
See, just like this...
catching my own reflection in the glass and
gazing right back...
choice_data_list: Hmm... Oh, this outfit really does...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! That kind of reflection works too♪
I'm so delighted you've taken such a liking
to the ensemble.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For lunch,
my number-one recommended cafe!
Isn't the interior simply gorgeous?
Their menu is wonderfully diverse,
and everything is delicious.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Soup curry, smørrebrød,
clubhouse sandwiches...
Oh, which set dessert should I choose?
Mmm~~...!
choice_data_list: We can share if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure? Fufu,
having two people around is such a lifesaver
at times like this.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Admiring stylish clothes while wearing a
stylish outfit.
Window shopping is an absolute classic!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look at those!
Aren't those sunglasses so cool♪
They have so much new eyewear in stock!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, what a sight...! Right,
it's just about that season, isn't it?
Would you mind if I tried some on?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Going bold and chunky with sleek all-black
frames.
A powerful look with serious impact!
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps something softer? A sheer,
mature brown.
Exuding a relaxed vibe,
like a chic horsegirl at a summer
resort...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Getting a jump on summer!
Pure white makes a fabulous accent piece!
With a somewhat retro silhouette,
it brings a touch of chic to a fresh,
breezy look.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh!
Every single one is simply too
wonderful...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her so completely carried away brought
a natural smile to my face.
I would have happily let her browse for as
long as she wanted, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, I'm so sorry!
I got totally caught up in looking at
sunglasses...!
choice_data_list: Haha, you've been wearing them a l...
Fufu, you've been wearing them a l...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ever since then,
they've become my latest obsession...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still,
it's time we went to look at other things.
Please,
allow me to style something that will make
you truly shine, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hats, belts, bags,
even smartphone cases sound lovely.
Now then, what would look best on you...?
choice_data_list: Oh, this looks like it would suit you!
Oh, this looks like it would suit you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Which one? ...Oh wow, how adorable!
The pattern matching is immaculate...
Every single piece here is crafted with such
meticulous care!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know!
It would go perfectly with those trousers
we saw earlier!
I'll be sure to try them on together in a
bit.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
Trainer!
What do you think of these cufflinks?
Between this pair and that pair,
which one speaks to you more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so,
we ended up picking out items for each
other.
I kept discovering more and more things that
looked wonderful on her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When a glass bottle,
clear and pristine as the open sky,
caught my eye.
Though delicate and weightless at a glance,
its stylish silhouette carried an undeniable
presence.
choice_data_list: That somehow reminds me of you, Fl...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Pardon? ...That perfume over there? Ah,
an eau de toilette.
The bottle design is so elegantly understated
and chic.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Shall we give the tester a try?
...Ooh♪ The top note has a crisp,
green scent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It smelled wonderful.
A mist over lush meadows, a forest breeze,
mountain greenery,
and the sensation of soaring into the high
skies...
All of those imagery instantly came to
mind.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As for the other notes... Mm-hmm,
such an unexpected combination,
yet delightfully playful.
I can't wait to see how the fragrance
develops.
choice_data_list: That scent suits you so well!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
! I thought so too.
It's crisp and refreshing,
perfect for everyday wear at the academy.
choice_data_list: It feels like... you could just wh...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Where did that come from?
choice_data_list: Like spreading your wings and taki...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't quite put it into words,
but it felt so uniquely *her*.
Smart, hardworking, faster than anyone else,
and dazzlingly radiant.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...You certainly have a refreshing
perspective.
Does it truly suit me that well?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(I haven't worn this type of fragrance very
often before, but...
somehow, I really like it...)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Mmm... Whatever should I do...?
choice_data_list: I know, let me buy it for you as a...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh! No,
I couldn't possibly accept a thank-you.
Bringing you out today was simply my own
selfish pleasure.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy it right now!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Eek! T-Trainer?!
Oh dear... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hmm-hmmm♪ Where is that perfume feature...
Ah, found it!
"The Complete Look:
Styling with Fragrance," is it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that tail scrunchie I bought today would
go wonderfully with that skirt!
Or wait,
maybe that powder blue dress would be even
better?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(How fascinating... Just one new fragrance,
and the inspiration won't stop flowing.
Even though I wouldn't have looked twice at
it until Trainer pointed it out.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(What is this little flutter in my heart?
Why is it happening... Ah!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I see. That must be it—!
